name: Dynamo components/src/dynamo/common/backend/disagg.py
notes: Source for the prefill-to-decode handoff contract as implemented. enforce_prefill_max_tokens(): 'clamp stop_conditions.max_tokens to 1 in PREFILL mode. Prefill workers only need the KV cache populated for the prompt; producing more than one token is wasted compute and breaks the prefill->decode handoff contract.' require_prefill_result(): a decode-mode worker raises if the request carries no prefill_result, i.e. the decode side treats the handoff payload as a hard precondition. extract_prefill_result() docstring: 'engines use the embedded disaggregated_params to resume from the KV cache the prefill peer already populated'. So the decoded-from-KV contract is explicit and engine-side, not implicit - which matters for the numerics gotcha.
